items.exampleEn: The team needed fresh ideas, so the new manager brought some in.
items.exampleZh: 團隊需要新的想法，所以新經理引進了一些。

items.exampleEn: Few people bought into such promises.
items.exampleZh: 很少人認同這樣的承諾。

items.exampleEn: She carried the plan through despite many problems.
items.exampleZh: 儘管問題重重，她還是貫徹了這個計畫。

items.exampleEn: Some pop bands churn out songs that all sound the same.
items.exampleZh: 有些流行樂團大量推出聽起來都一樣的歌。

items.exampleEn: Work usually eases off after the holidays.
items.exampleZh: 假期過後，工作通常會比較輕鬆。

items.exampleEn: Neither side was willing to enter into talks.
items.exampleZh: 雙方都不願意展開談判。

items.exampleEn: It's good to have something to fall back on.
items.exampleZh: 有個可以依靠的備案是好事。

items.sentenceEn: The coach told us to ease off a little before the race.
items.sentenceZh: 教練要我們在比賽前稍微放鬆一點。

items.audioEn: The summer festival brought in more money than any other event this year.
items.audioZh: 夏季節慶賺到的錢比今年任何一場活動都多。
options: It was canceled because the weather was bad
It earned the most money of the year

items.sentenceEn: Teachers often fall back on old methods when they are tired.
items.sentenceZh: 老師累的時候常常會依靠舊的教學方法。

items.sentenceEn: It takes courage to carry through a plan like this.
items.sentenceZh: 貫徹這樣的計畫需要勇氣。

items.stemEn: The factory can ____ five thousand phones a day.
items.stemZh: 這家工廠一天可以大量生產五千支手機。

items.stemEn: Many customers didn't ____ the company's claims about its new product.
items.stemZh: 很多顧客並不認同這家公司對新產品的說法。

items.passageEn: For decades, the Lu family's small factory made wooden toys by hand. When larger companies began making cheap plastic toys and churning them out by the million, sales fell sharply. Instead of giving up, the family entered into a partnership with a design school. Together they created a new line of toys made from recycled paper. The plan was risky, and they had little money to fall back on, but they kept going. Today, the paper toys bring in most of the company's income, and they are sold in twelve countries. Parents like them because they are light and safe.
items.passageZh: 幾十年來，盧家的小工廠一直用手工製作木製玩具。當大公司開始製造便宜的塑膠玩具，而且一做就是上百萬個，工廠的銷量大幅下滑。這家人沒有放棄，而是和一所設計學校展開合作，一起開發出一系列用回收紙做的玩具。這個計畫風險很高，他們也沒什麼錢可以依靠，但他們堅持了下去。現在，紙做的玩具為公司賺進大部分的收入，並且在十二個國家販售。家長喜歡這些玩具，因為它們又輕又安全。

questions.questionZh: 工廠的銷量為什麼大幅下滑？
options: 便宜的塑膠玩具搶走市場
設計學校推出了比較便宜的紙玩具
木頭的價格突然漲了很多
工廠的老師傅都退休了

questions.questionZh: 現在公司大部分的收入來自哪裡？

items.promptZh: 政府打算引進新的交通規則。
referenceEn: The government plans to bring in new traffic rules.
The government is planning to bring in new rules for traffic.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「引進」（例如 bring in new traffic rules 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 introduce new traffic rules 等）
「打算」可寫，例如 plans to、is planning to、is going to 等
「交通規則」可寫，例如 traffic rules、rules for traffic 等

items.promptZh: 到了傍晚，雨勢漸漸減弱了。
referenceEn: By evening, the rain had eased off.
The rain slowly eased off in the evening.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「減弱」（例如 the rain eased off 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 let up、died down、eased、became lighter 等）
時態可用過去式、過去完成式或現在完成式（例如 eased off、had eased off、has eased off 等）
「到了傍晚」可寫，例如 by evening、in the evening 等
